notes.title: TRAILS - v1.3
notes.content:
New
added an option to change the ship colors

added an option to remove controller button icons

touch devices can now be used properly on the overworld


Improved
fixed some Clumsy Button Assignments: pressing CTRL while drawing a path with the mouse should not lead to errors anymore

stepping through the current solution via hotkey or timeline now animates the current step

significantly improved performance on low-end hardware

locking paths is now indicated more clearly

notes.title: TRAILS v1.1 - musi Talise
notes.content:
New
new translation to Toki Pona

new secret achievement

added a dark mode
Improvements
several performance improvements

"toggle draw" is now applied to mouse input

controls screen now shows all key bindings

controller and keyboard navigation now show which path will be used when drawing is started, similar to mouse input

fixed a visual bug for macs with M1 chip

notes.title: TRAILS Releases May 29th
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that TRAILS will release in just under a month on the 29th of May!

[previewyoutube=jcl6h1oa65o;full][/previewyoutube]

TRAILS is a cozy puzzle game in which players guide sandships across a crumbling desert to reach isolated outposts. Players draw lines on a grid in order to plot the movement of ships that cannot selfintersect or visit a tile twice. When done drawing they can start the simulation and see the outcome their routes produced. If the ships reach their goal without collision and while satisfying all victory conditions they win and advance to the next level. Over the course of the game more and more interacting mechanics get added to the game, requiring players to supply outposts with vital cargo, unlock new passages, juggle items, avoid hostile drones and support allied ships.

If you are interested in TRAILS here are a few things you can do to stay informed and support us: 

Whislist the game
Join our discord community
Tell your friends

See you soon!
